source_rule: Reuse immutable BTC through September; download previously unused ETH and Oct 1-25 daily archives only after configuration freeze. No future calendar data beyond current completed period.

validation.role: Development hyperparameter selection; 2026 Q2/Q3 BTC already examined in v1 and never called fresh again

evaluations.name: external_asset
evaluations.status: Fresh asset holdout, same historical market environment as previously examined BTC; not an independent time regime

evaluations.name: new_time
evaluations.status: Fresh forward-time relative to v1 data, too short alone for stable-effect claims

evaluations.name: new_time
evaluations.status: Fresh asset/time; shares dates and market risk with BTC, not 25 additional independent dates

target: Next UTC day RV=sum of 288 squared five-minute log returns. Predict positive conditional-mean candidate by log-link Gamma quasi-likelihood. QLIKE primary for v2; log-MSE remains compulsory secondary so change in objective cannot hide earlier metric.
origin: Features available after origin day closes; target next day. Rolling features include origin and earlier data only. No true-network labels.

refit.static_rule: Fit once strictly before each evaluation window. Adaptive fits same window then every 7 target days, using outcomes completed before that block.

selection: Per asset use Q1 mean QLIKE for Gamma and Q1 log-MSE for log-Ridge. First select return-channel penalty using matched static/adaptive return-only procedure; then select volume penalty including exact return-only off option. No final selection across models/assets/periods. Zero extra channel is a legitimate result.
secondary: Matched loss-function, representation and update controls. Evaluate state-vs-legacy-volume and adaptive-vs-static; retain all results and view group penalties, not causal attribution.

bootstrap.primary_family: Three primary contrasts, one for each fresh evaluation; Holm across three. Other model contrasts exploratory with their own clearly separated per-evaluation family. Never pool two asset-day samples as independent.

practical_gate: Project-defined research gate, not an industry standard: at least 5% QLIKE reduction and primary CI above zero on external asset; nonnegative log-MSE improvement; new-time checks not contradicting. Because new-time only 25 dates, any stability/utility conclusion stays provisional. Otherwise report insufficient evidence.
risk_budget_diagnostic: Uncapped theoretical target-volatility exposure gives realised variance/budget ratio RV/forecast. Report mean excess above one and frequency above two, with no PnL, execution, leverage recommendation or guaranteed risk reduction.

mechanism.rule: Mean activity/return second moment matched in stationary expectation; joint empirical (r,V) law exactly retained when shuffling full PersistentActivity pairs. Models are hypothetical controlled extensions, not fitted real-market mechanisms.

figures: Mechanism intervention (memory vs joint constraint), matched-baseline skill forest split external/new time, chronology/selected shrinkage diagnostics, new-time forecasts/risk-budget diagnostic. All tables and limits retained.
data_policy: Binance Vision attribution, observed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 on market-derived artifacts; full real archives local; old configurations/results/packages unchanged.
